whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Lemon Chilli Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 4.2★ reviews in Kidwaipuri, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature food gallery, aur online menu integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/lemonchilli

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Lemon Chilli Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a mobile-first menu, direct WhatsApp table reservation, and a showcase of your top dishes right here in Kidwaipuri, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
